# Committee/Club Management

## Problem

The school needs a way to organize and manage various committees and clubs beyond just extracurricular activities.

## Recommended Solution

Add functionality to create and manage committees/clubs with the following features:

- Ability to create new committees with names and descriptions
- Assign roles to members (e.g., President, Vice President, Secretary, Treasurer)
- Track committee members and their positions
- View all committees and their current membership

## Context

Committees can be stored similarly to activities but with additional fields for organizational structure and member roles. This will help teachers better organize student involvement in school governance and special interest groups.
